title: Prepare the v6 remaining-stages rehearsal fixture (no Grant)
problem: The remaining prove-two-action-unattended-production stages need a fresh, isolated fixture rather than reuse of v5 evidence or an existing live policy.
desired_effect: Create or validate the v6 fixture, register and sync it, seed only its first build packet for codex-cli, and record the exact inactive policy revision that the separate Grant must pin. It leaves the Grant unpressed.

does: Registers and synchronizes only the v6 fixture Project
Seeds the first fixture Action build packet for codex-cli
Records an inactive policy revision for the later Grant
never_does: Never starts, stops, or restarts the worker
Never launches, terminates, or resumes a Session
Never presses the paired Grant, settles completion, merges, deploys, or uses credentials

success.effect: A clean v6 fixture and receipt exist; the paired Grant has a concrete revision to verify but has not run.
success.next: Review morning-runbook.md, then use the separate one-shot Grant only when ready to begin the live proof.

failure.effect: No production policy, worker, or Session changed; a timestamped failure handoff identifies the failed precondition.
failure.next: Correct the named local fixture or inactive-policy condition and rerun preparation.
